prompt:
Production sprite source for PixelRogue: Xixifu NORMAL appearance ONLY. Ref1 W idle defines physical body proportions, head/skull, ordinary costume and shading; ref2 approved A04 turnaround defines matching front/back identity and correct hair/hood layer. Keep SAME compact body, no taller torso/legs or shrinking head. Non-pixel smooth hand-drawn fantasy RPG miniature, dark colored clean outlines, restrained2-3tone painted/cel shading, broad still hair masses and fabric folds, no microtexture, no3D, no jagged pixel grid.

Identity invariant: human-looking summoner girl, BLACK irises (charcoal, not glowing violet), long near-black hair with muted purple reflected shading. Human ears, no horns, wings, tail. Plain charcoal mid-calf robe, lavender sleeve/hem lining, small silver butterfly clasp, simple cloth waist tie, dark leggings, rounded short black ankle boots. Thin dark wood staff with small purple crystal, held in anatomical RIGHT hand, not a huge ornate scepter. Hood folded down on robe behind ALL hair. Long hair drapes continuously over and outside hood to hips, no cloth band cuts through hair. NO hair/cloth wind or floating locks. Mild15-degree viewing elevation, same camera as W idle and all directional sprites. Fully visible feet, hair, staff and fingertips. True transparent background; NO glow, halo, gradient, shadows, ground, particles, symbols, text, border, guides, additional characters, extra limbs or props. Leave generous empty margins around ALL extremities.
Create FOUR authored walking frames, evenly in a2x2 transparent square sheet, reading order top-left,top-right,bottom-left,bottom-right. Each frame is the SAME Xixifu NORMAL sprite at exact same physical size, camera angle, body proportions and head drawing as FIRST reference (same-direction idle). Second reference W idle is supplementary consistency, third A04 is costume construction only. Leave12% empty space on EACH edge of each quadrant; scale ALL FOUR equally small enough to fit hair/staff/boots fully. Four whole people, one per quadrant; no overlapping grid boundaries. Every frame crown height and centerline essentially fixed, no head tilt, rocking torso, side sway, scaling or direction change. Lower body steps, upper body remains steady, right staff hand keeps staff steady alongside body, free arm only small natural counter-motion. Use contact→passing through body's middle→opposite contact→opposite passing. Passing poses MUST have a foot lifted/tucked beneath body center and knees modestly flexed, clearly different from wide contact poses. Robe hem follows modest leg motion without transforming costume. Feet never disappear into the robe. No blurry smear or morph.
Direction NORTH, STRICT REAR walking straight AWAY/up-screen. No face/cheek/eyes/ears in ANY frame, no backward head turn; back of skull stays centered and shoulders square. Hair stays as continuous outer curtain over hidden lowered hood; no U/V cloth stripe crossing. Right-hand staff stays on VIEWER-RIGHT in ALL four frames, free hand viewer-left. DO NOT rock head or shift torso left/right. The step is along depth (up/down picture), not a side-to-side sway.
Frame1 VIEWER-LEFT leg extends BACK toward viewer/bottom, heel raised so the underside of its boot sole is visible and low; VIEWER-RIGHT leg supports ahead/upper under body.
Frame2 VIEWER-RIGHT supports under hip; VIEWER-LEFT knee bends and its boot passes CLOSE UNDER center with raised heel; boot tips point away.
Frame3 REVERSE LEGS FROM FRAME1: VIEWER-RIGHT leg extends BACK toward viewer/bottom, heel lifted showing underside sole, VIEWER-LEFT supports ahead/upper. The clearly visible sole MUST switch from left side in frame1 to right side in frame3.
Frame4 REVERSE LEGS FROM FRAME2: VIEWER-LEFT supports under hip; VIEWER-RIGHT knee bends with boot passing near center and raised heel. Frame2 and4 lifted heels MUST be opposite feet.
No identical-contact repeat, no mirror of entire character because staff must remain viewer-right. Modest smooth steps, both legs connected to correct hips, no crossed/tangled legs. Same head/body proportions and size as N ready reference. Each hair tip/staff/boot fully inside equal quadrant with ample margins. True transparency with no glow/halo/shadow/gradient/background.
visual_review: Four strict rear depth-stepping figures, no face/eyes/ears; outer hair continuous over hidden hood. Contact1/3 visibly expose opposite soles, passing2/4 tuck opposite boots under body, preserving staff viewer-right. No clipping or halo. Native head/torso texture variations require rig review; not a final packed atlas.
